mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transaction_order WHERE profit_status = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_order WHERE profit_status = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction_order (order_no, agent_code, agent_name, transaction_amount, order_status, profit_status, transaction_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{agentCode}, #{agentName}, #{transactionAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{profitStatus}, #{transactionTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE transaction_order SET agent_code = #{agentCode}, agent_name = #{agentName}, transaction_amount = #{transactionAmount}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, profit_status = #{profitStatus} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE transaction_order SET profit_status = #{profitStatus} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
